resumeText:
Rohit Deshmukh | Pune | rohit.deshmukh@example.com

SUMMARY
Data engineering manager with 14 years in data platforms for lending and financial services, the last 6 managing data engineering teams.

EXPERIENCE
Data Engineering Manager, Godavari FinServ, Pune (2020 - present)
- Manage a team of 11 data engineers across ingestion, platform and analytics engineering.
- Hired 7 data engineers and set the team's hiring bar and interview loops.
- Run the Databricks lakehouse on AWS with Delta Lake bronze, silver and gold layers.
- Own 300 batch pipelines feeding risk, finance and regulatory reports with agreed delivery SLAs.
- Moved PySpark jobs to autoscaling job clusters and tuned shuffle-heavy joins.
- Cut monthly Databricks and S3 spend by 30% through cluster policies and storage lifecycle rules.
- Rolled out Unity Catalog with column-level access controls and lineage for the RBI audit.
- Agree data delivery priorities every quarter with the risk office, finance and product heads.

Lead Data Engineer, Tapti Data Systems, Pune (2015 - 2020)
- Led 5 engineers building Airflow-orchestrated Spark pipelines on Hadoop and later AWS EMR.
- Designed dimensional models for the lending data mart used by 200 analysts.

ETL Developer, Narmada Softech, Mumbai (2012 - 2015)
- Built Informatica ETL jobs loading Oracle data warehouses for insurance clients.

SKILLS
PySpark, SQL, Databricks, Delta Lake, Airflow, AWS, Informatica

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2012
